speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Rotator Cuff Tear (likely supraspinatus)
The insidious onset, age (55), diabetes, and specific difficulty with overhead activities like brushing hair strongly suggest a full-thickness rotator cuff tear rather than just tendinopathy. I need to confirm the extent of the tear and check for calcific tendinitis. REQUEST TEST: Left Shoulder_X_Ray and LEFT_SHOULDER_MRI.
